callbacks.message_text: Hi, this is Ana Morales calling back about my infusion follow-up. I need a 30-minute visit. Mondays or Wednesdays are the days that work for me, and morning is best, roughly 8:00 to 11:00 AM. Please do not put me on May 6, 2026 because I will be traveling. The appointment has to be at least 48 hours after my last iron infusion on May 3, 2026, and I need to fast for 8 hours before the visit.

Hello clinic, I need to book my 45-minute wound check. Tuesdays or Thursdays are fine. I cannot get there before 1:30 PM, and I would like the visit wrapped up by 4:00 PM. Please skip May 12, 2026 because of my daughter's graduation. Also, the check has to be no sooner than one week after my cast removal on May 5, 2026.

This is Carl Nguyen. I only need a 20-minute follow-up to review results. Fridays are the only days I can step away from work, and 9:00 AM to 10:30 AM is ideal. I cannot come on May 22, 2026 because of a school field trip, and I am out of town on May 29, 2026. Please make sure the visit lands within 3 days after the MRI on May 20, 2026.

I need a 60-minute nutrition follow-up. Monday, Tuesday, or Friday all work. On Mondays and Fridays, 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM is best. On Tuesdays, please keep it between 3:00 PM and 5:00 PM. Do not schedule me on June 2, 2026 because I will be at dialysis. The visit needs to be at least 14 days after I finish my steroid taper on May 18, 2026, and I should not eat for 6 hours before the appointment.
